changeSet.author: welcome-home
changeSet.comment: Returns one access link and its lock without an owner context, for the guest flow.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION resolve_link(requested_link_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE ( link_id uuid, owner_id uuid, lock_id uuid, token_version integer, valid_from timestamptz, valid_until timestamptz, revoked_at timestamptz, lock_name text, lock_time_zone text, lock_active boolean ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ SELECT link.id, link.owner_id, link.lock_id, link.token_version, link.valid_from, link.valid_until, link.revoked_at, lock.name, lock.time_zone, lock.active FROM public.access_link link JOIN public.lock lock ON lock.owner_id = link.owner_id AND lock.id = link.lock_id WHERE link.id = requested_link_id $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION resolve_link(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION resolve_link(uuid) TO app_user;
